observation: The first one-component all-quad correction used a four-sided inset/extrusion for the lens. Subdivision rounded the barrel but left the terminal cap reading as a square plate.
root_cause: The radial control loop had only four authored vertices, so the control cage encoded the wrong design shape even though it was manifold and all-quad.
decision: Reject the technically passing result and route the front surface into a circular radial loop before extruding the lens.
lesson: Connected topology is not sufficient by itself; the sparse control cage must still encode the intended silhouette.
